title: Opening protectives.
officialText: Fire doors in horizontal exits shall be self-closing or automatic-closing when activated by a smoke detector in accordance with Section 715.4.8.3. Doors, where located in a cross-corridor condition shall be automatic-closing by activation of a smoke detector installed in accordance with Section 715.4.8.3.
